title: Mouth & esophagus — cephalic cue to LES handoff

basedOn: Standard GI physiology: cephalic phase, salivation, mastication and mechanical bio-accessibility, salivary amylase / lingual lipase, bolus formation, and the swallow (oral -> pharyngeal -> esophageal -> LES) sequence. NIDDK digestive-system education (mouth, saliva, swallow). Teaching averages.

inputs.description: 1 = food packet; 0 = no meal solids this event

entryMode.label: 0 - Entry mode (payload kind)
entryMode.detail: Which oral path? Food mills; liquid skips shear; a capsule is a swallow-first object. Defaults to food-form when intake flags are unset.

choices.note: Low matrix integrity -> treat as liquid/refined.

cephalicCue.label: 1 - Cephalic cue (sight / smell / expect)
cephalicCue.detail: Before the first bite, the CNS anticipates intake: appetite circuits and autonomic prep fire. Weak when eating distracted / tube-fed (teaching cases).

salivaPreload.label: 2 - Saliva preload
salivaPreload.detail: Parotid / submandibular / sublingual output rises: water, mucins, electrolytes, enzymes. Lubrication + first solvent for starch.

incisionGrab.label: 3 - Incision / grab (bite)
incisionGrab.detail: Incisors and lips portion a bite size the jaw and tongue can control.

masticationShear.label: 4 - Mastication shear
masticationShear.detail: Molars grind; jaw cycles raise surface area. Enzymes only act on the exposed face - particle size is the first lever on later extraction (mechanical bio-accessibility).

edgeCases.effect: Low integrity / soft form -> fewer effective shear cycles; surface-area gain is small, and a soft/refined matrix travels faster and less buffered downstream.

matrixSurfaceArea.label: 5 - Matrix surface-area open
matrixSurfaceArea.detail: Cell walls, connective tissue, and emulsions fracture. The surface-area coefficient rises; downstream amylase/pepsin/lipase inherit this number.

salivaryAmylase.label: 6 - Salivary amylase
salivaryAmylase.detail: Starts starch -> maltose/oligosaccharides while the bolus is still oral. Stops later in acid; the early window still matters for high-carb soft meals.

edgeCases.effect: Very low available carbohydrate - the amylase step is nearly idle (still runs as a no-op teaching node).

lingualLipase.label: 7 - Lingual lipase (minor)
lingualLipase.detail: Minor triglyceride nick in the mouth; more relevant for infants and high-fat teaching. Not the main fat engine (bile/pancreas later).

bolusForm.label: 8 - Bolus formation
bolusForm.detail: The tongue packs particles + saliva into a lubricated bolus sized for a safe swallow.

swallowVoluntary.label: 9 - Voluntary swallow initiate
swallowVoluntary.detail: The oral phase of swallow is voluntary: the tongue propels the bolus into the oropharynx; then the sequence becomes automatic.

epiglottisProtect.label: 10 - Airway protect (epiglottis)
epiglottisProtect.detail: The epiglottis covers the laryngeal inlet; the soft palate seals the nasopharynx. The aspiration path must stay closed.

esophagealPeristalsis.label: 11 - Esophageal peristalsis
esophagealPeristalsis.detail: Primary (then secondary if needed) peristalsis drives the bolus; gravity is secondary. Transit ~5-10 s (teaching average).

lesOpen.label: 12 - LES open -> stomach
lesOpen.detail: The lower esophageal sphincter relaxes to admit the bolus, then reseals against reflux.

liquidPath.label: L1 - Liquid / low-shear entry
liquidPath.detail: Hydration or refined liquid: little or no mastication. Cephalic may still fire; shear work is near zero -> faster gastric emptying later.

edgeCases.effect: Liquid/refined path skips mechanical disruption -> less buffered, faster transit downstream.

liquidSwallow.label: L2 - Fluid swallow + protect
liquidSwallow.detail: Same airway-protect sequence; lower viscosity -> different sensory load than a solid bolus.

capsulePath.label: C1 - Capsule / tablet receive
capsulePath.detail: Solid dose form: object integrity is intentional (delayed release downstream). Not milled like food.

capsuleCoFluid.label: C2 - Co-fluid check
capsuleCoFluid.detail: Best practice: swallow the dose with fluid. A dry swallow is an edge case.

choices.note: No hydration flag -> dry-swallow edge case.

capsuleDry.label: C3a - Dry swallow (edge)
capsuleDry.detail: Higher residue / delayed esophageal clearance risk in teaching models. Prefer hydration = 1.

capsuleWet.label: C3b - Dose + fluid swallow
capsuleWet.detail: The capsule rides a fluid vehicle through protect -> esophagus -> LES.

handoff.label: 13 - Handoff -> stomach
handoff.detail: Oral/esophageal segment closed. The stomach receives the bolus (or fluid/dose) for acid work.
